rows.reference: Siminoff ya ce tallace-tallace sun bunkasa bayan bayyanarsa a 2013 a cikin wani taron fim na Shark Tank inda taron kwamitin ya nuna ba da tallafin farawa.

rows.output: Yayin da wani magani na gwaji ya bayyana yana iya rage mutuwar cutar Ebola, har yanzu ba a sami wani magani da aka nuna a fili ba don kula da cutar da ke akwai.
rows.reference: Yayinda allurar gwaji rigakafi guda daya ta bayyana tana iya rage mutuwar cutar ta Ebola, har zuwa yanzu, babu wasu kwayoyi da aka nuna da suka dace da maganin cututtukan da suke kamuwa da su.

rows.output: Wani haɗin garkuwar jiki, ZMapp, da farko ya nuna alkawari a filin, amma bincike na hukuma ya nuna cewa yana da ƙarancin fa'ida fiye da yadda aka yi fatan hana mutuwar.
rows.reference: Wani hadaddiyar giyar, ZMapp, da farko ya nuna alƙawari a fagen, amma nazarin yau da kullun ya nuna cewa ba shi da fa'ida fiye da yadda ake neman hana mutuwa.

rows.output: A cikin gwajin PALM, ZMapp ya yi aiki a matsayin kulawa, wanda ke nufin masana kimiyya sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin tushe kuma sun kwatanta sauran magani uku da shi.
rows.reference: a nan gwajin PALM, ZMapp yayi bauta a wajen kula, hakan na nufin masana fasaha sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin kasan idan ka kimanta da hanyoyin guda uku nashi.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Gymnastics ta Amurka tana goyan bayan wasan Olympics na Amurka (USOC) da wasu wasu abubuwan da suka shafi Olympics da kuma yarda da buƙatar da ake da ita na tallafa wa muhalli mai aminci ga duk 'yan wasa.
rows.reference: Masu wasan tsalle tsalle na Amurka sun goyi bayan wasikar kwamitin gasar olympic tare da yarda da cikakkiyar bukatar duk masu wasan olympic da su yada maganar samar da yanayi mara hadari ga dukkan yan wasanmu.

rows.output: Muna yarda da sanarwar USOC cewa sha'anin 'yan wasa da kungiyar su, da wasanni, za su fi amfani ta hanyar ci gaba da sauye-sauye a cikin kungiyar mu, maimakon cire takardan shedar.
rows.reference: Mun yarda da bayanin USOC cewa bukatun 'yan wasanmu da kungiyar mu, da wasanninsu, na iya zama mafi alheri ta ci gaba tare da canji mai ma'ana a cikin ƙungiyarmu, maimakon ƙaddamar da doka.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Gymnastics ta Amurka tana goyan bayan binciken da ba a san shi ba wanda zai iya bayyana yadda cin zarafi na irin wannan girma da masu tsira daga Larryassar suka bayyana da jaruntaka suka yi ba a gano shi ba na tsawon lokaci, kuma tana rungumar duk wani gyara da ya dace da kuma wanda ya dace.
rows.reference: Kungiyan daki motsa jiki na USA na goyon bayan bincike mai zaman kanta wadda take zaton zata kara haske kan cin zarafi wadda wadanda suka tsira daga Larry Nassar suka bayana wadda ba a gano ba na tsawon lokaci kuma ke rungume da duk wani canji mai muhimmanci.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin wasan motsa jiki na Amurka da kungiyar Olympic ta Amurka suna da burin ɗaya - yin wasan motsa jiki, da sauran su, mafi aminci da za a iya yi ga 'yan wasa don bin mafarkinsu a cikin yanayi mai aminci, mai kyau, da kuma mai karfi.
rows.reference: Gidan motsa jiki na Amurka da USOC suna da manufa ɗaya - sa wasan motsa jiki, da sauransu, ya zama mai aminci yadda zai yiwu 'yan wasa su bi mafarkinsu cikin aminci, tabbatacce kuma mai ba da ƙarfi.

rows.output: A duk shekarun 1960, Brzezinski ya yi aiki da John F. Kennedy a matsayin mai ba shi shawara, sannan kuma a ƙarƙashin gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.
rows.reference: A duk tsawon 1960, Brzezinski yayi ma John F. Kenedy aiki a matsayin mai bada shawara kuma yayi aiki da gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.

rows.output: A lokacin zabukan 1976, ya ba da shawara ga Carter kan harkokin waje, daga baya ya yi aiki a matsayin mai ba da shawara kan tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, inda ya gaji Henry Kissinger.
rows.reference: A yayin zabukan 1976 ya shawarci Carter kan manufofin kasashen waje, sannan ya zama mai ba da shawara kan Tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, ya gaji Henry Kissinger.

rows.output: A matsayin NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter wajen kula da harkokin duniya ta hanyar diflomasiya, kamar yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaiton dangantaka tsakanin Amurka da Sin a karshen shekarun 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin kama da sata na Iran, 1979; da kuma mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.
rows.reference: kasancewarsa dan NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter a harkokin dokokin kasashen waje wajen kula da lamuran duniya, kamar Yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaita alaƙar Amurka da China tana tunanin ƙarshen shekarun 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin garkuwar da Iran, 1979; da mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.

rows.output: Fim ɗin, wanda ya ƙunshi Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya samuɗ nominations a dukkan manyan nau'ikan.
rows.reference: Fin ɗin, da ke nuna Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya sami shiga cikin duk manyan ɓangarorin gasar.

rows.output: Gosling da Stone sun samiomin Best Actor da Actress.
rows.reference: Gosling da Stone sun sami shiga neman cikin kyautar Fitaccen Jarumi da Jaruma.

rows.output: Sauranomin sun haɗa da Mafi kyawun Hoto, Darakta, Cinematography, Zane-zane, Gyaran Fim, Maki na Asali, Zane-zane na Samarwa, Gyaran Sauti, Haɗa Sauti, da Asalin Screenplay.
rows.reference: Sauran zaɓin sun hada da Hoto Mafi Kyau, Darakta, Majigi, Tsara Tufafi, Gyaran fina-finai, Makin Asali, Tsara Shiri, Gyara Sauti, Haɗa Sauti da kuma Asalin Labari.

rows.output: Biyu daga cikin wakoki daga fim ɗin, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) da City of Stars, sun samiomin da aka zaba mafi kyawun wakoki na asali. Studio na Lionsgate sun samiomin 26 - fiye da kowane studio.
rows.reference: Waƙoƙi biyu daga fim, Audition (Wawaye Waɗanda Suke Mafarki) da Birnin Taurari, sun karɓi zaɓi don mafi kyawun waƙar asali. Lionsgate studio ta sami nadin 26 - fiye da kowane sauran ɗakunan studio.

rows.output: A karshen Lahadi, shugaban kasar Amurka Donald Trump, a cikin wata sanarwa da ya gabatar ta hanyar sakatare na ma'aikatar yada labarai, ya sanar da cewa sojojin Amurka za su bar Siriya.
rows.reference: A daren ranar Lahadi shugaban kasar Amurka Donald Trump a cikin wata sanarwa da aka fitar ta sanarwar sakataren, ya sanar da dakarun kasar Amurka zasu bar kasar Syria.

rows.output: An yi sanarwar ne bayan Trump ya yi magana ta waya da shugaban Turkiyya Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
rows.reference: An bayar da sanarwar ce bayan Trump ya yi ganawa ta wayar salula da Shugaban Turkiyya Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

rows.output: Turkiyya za ta dauki nauyin kare 'yan ta'adda da aka kama daga ISIS, wanda, bisa ga wata sanarwa, kasashen Turai suka ki dawo da su.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Turkiyya za ta karbi aikin gadin mayakan ISIS da aka kama waɗanda, sanarwar ta ce, kasashen Turai suka ki mayar da su.

rows.output: Wannan ba kawai ya tabbatar da cewa aƙalla wasu dinosaurs suna da fuka-fuki, wani ra'ayi da ya yadu tuni, ba, har ma ya bayar da cikakkun bayanai na fossils da ba za a iya samu ba, kamar launi da shimfidar uku.
rows.reference: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa ba wai kawai wasu dabbobin dinasour suna da gashi ba, wata fadar ma da ta yadu, amma ta yi cikakken bayanin da rubabbun halittu ba za su iya ba, kamar su launi da kuma tsarin kashi uku.

rows.output: Masana kimiyya sun ce wannan dabbobi yana da fuka-fukan kasa mai launin chestnut-brown a saman da kasa ko kuma kasa mai launin carotenoid.
rows.reference: Masana ilimin kimiya sun ce fiffiken dabbar launi kasa ne a sama mai dauke da kodaden launi da launin toka-toka ta karkashin ta.

rows.output: An gano wannan kuma yana ba da haske game da ci gaban fuka-fuki a cikin tsuntsaye.
rows.reference: Binciken ya kuma ba da haske game da juyin halittar fukafiki a tsuntsaye.

rows.output: "Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụọkọ dị afọ anọ na-adịghị ọrịa shuga nke nabu ọrịa shuga."
rows.reference: Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụ oke ọnwa anọ na-arịabu ọrịa shuga mana ha anaghị arịazi ya.

rows.output: Dọkịta Ehud Ur, onye prọfesọ ọgwụ na Mahadum Dalhousie dị na Halifax, Nova Scotia, na onye isi oche nke ngalaba ọgwụ na sayensị nke �tù Diabetes nke Canada dọrụ aka ná ntị na nyocha ahụ ka nọ n'oge mbụ ya.
rows.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, ọkammụta nke ọgwụ na Mahadum Dalhousie nọ na Halifax, Nova Scotia na onye isi oche nke ngalaba ụlọ ọgwụ na sayensi ahụ nke Òtù Ọrịa Shuga ndị Kanada dọrọ aka na ntị na nnyocha ahụ ka nọ n’oge ndị mbụ ya.

rows.output: Dị ka ụfọdụ ndị ọzọ, ọ na-enwe obi abụọ ma ọ bụ shuga nwere ike ịgwọ ya, na-ekwu na nchọpụta ndị a enweghị ihe metụtara ndị nwere ọrịa shuga 1.
rows.reference: Ka ndị ọkachamara ndị ọzọ, o kwenyeghị na a ga agwọtanwu ọrịa shuga, o depụtara na ihe nchọpụta ndị a enweghị mmetụta nye ndị nwere ọrịa shuga Taịp 1.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye ode akwụkwọ nke Nobel Committee for Literature na Swedish Academy, kwuputara n'ihu ọha n'ụzọ doro anya n'oge ihe omume redio na Sveriges Radio na Sweden na, n'ihi na ha enwetaghị Bob Dylan n'ụzọ ọ bụla banyere mmeri ya na 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, ha kwụsịrị ịnwale ịkpọtụrụ ya.
rows.reference: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye odeakwụkwọ Nobel kọmitii maka akwụkwọ agụmagụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ Swidin, kwuputara n'ihu ọha na ihe omume redio na Sveriges Redio dị na Swidin, mgbe o siere kọmitii ahụ ike inweta Bob Dilan gbasara mmeri na ihe nrite Nobel na mpaghara Akwụkwọ agụmagụ nke afọ 2016 o nwetara, na ha ahapụlarị mbọ ha na-agba inweta ya.

rows.output: Danius kwuru, "N'ụzọ dị ugbu a, anyị na-eme ihe ọ bụla. Ederela m akwụkwọ ozi na email ndị ọrụ ya kacha nso, ha zaghachiri n'ụzọ enyi. N'ụzọ dị otú a, ọ bụ ihe zuru ezu."
rows.reference: Danius si, "Ugbu a anyị anaghị eme ihe ọbụla. Akpọọlam oku ma zijere onye ya na ya kacha arụkọ ozi ịntaneetị ma nwetekwa ụsa nnabata. Ugbua nke ahụ zuru oke."

rows.output: N'oge gara aga, onye isi Ring, Jamie Siminoff, kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ malitere mgbe igodo ụlọ ya adịghịaa nụ n'ụlọ ọrụ ya n'ime ụlọ ya.
rows.reference: Na mbu,onye isi Ring, Jamie Siminoff, kwuru na ulo oru ya bidoro mgbe onughi mgbirigba ya n’ulo ahia ya di na ime ebe o na adoba ugboala ya.

rows.output: O wuru ụlọ WiFi, o kwuru.
rows.reference: O kwuru na ọ rụrụ mgbịrịgba ụzọ ji WiFi arụ ọrụ.

rows.output: Siminoff kwuru na ahịa rụrụ ọrụ nke ọma mgbe ọ pụtasịrị na ihe omume Tank Shark nke 2013 ebe ndị otu ihe ngosi ahụ jụrụ itinye ego na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Siminoff sị na orire ahịa gbaliri elu ka ogosichara n'ihe nkiri Shak Tank n'afọ 2013 ebe ndị ndozi ihe ngosi jụrụ itinye ego na mbido.

rows.output: N'oge ikpeazụ nke afọ 2017, Siminoff pụtara naọwa telivishọn ahịa QVC.
rows.reference: Na ngwụcha 2017, e gosiri Siminoff na chanel igbe onyonyo QVC.

rows.output: Ring nwekwara dozie ikpe megide ụlọ ọrụ nchekwa ọzọ, ADT Corporation.
rows.reference: Ring dozikwara otu ikpe ha na ụlọ ọrụ ọzọ na-ahụ maka nchekwa, ADT Corporation nwere.

rows.output: N'ihi na otu ọgwụ nnwale na-egosi na ọ nwere ike ibelata ọnwụ Ebola, ruo ugbu a, ọ nweghị ọgwụ ndị a na-egosi nke ọma maka ịgwọ ọrịa a na-efe efe.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ eziokwu na otu ọgwụ mgbochi aka na-ele anya egosila na o nwere ike ịbelata oke ndị mmadụ ji anwụ n'ihi ọrịa Ebola, mana ruo ugbu a, enwebeghi ọgwụ ọbụla gosiri hooha na o nwere ike ịgwọ onye bu ọrịa a.

rows.output: Otu ọgwụgwọ antibody, ZMapp, na mbụ gosiri na ọ bara uru n'ọhịa ahụ, mana nyocha ndị ọzọ gosiri na ọ nwere uru dị nta karịa ka a tụrụ anya n'ịgbochi ọnwụ.
rows.reference: Otu antibọdi, ZMapp, gosiburu olileanya, mana ka elebakwuru ya anya, achọpụtara na ọbaghị uru na-igbochi ọnwụ ka esiri chee.

rows.output: N'ime PALM trial, ZMapp rụrụ ọrụ dị ka njikwa, nke pụtara na ndị ọkà mmụta ji ya dị ka ntụaka ma tulee ọgwụ atọ ndị ọzọ na ya.
rows.reference: Na nnwale PALM, eji ZMapp mere ihe nruba ama, nke a putara na ndi sayentist jiri ya mee baseline tunyere ogwugwo ato ozo.

rows.output: Ndị USA Gymnastics na-akwado akwụkwọ nke United States Olympic Committee ma na-anabata mkpa zuru oke nke ezinụlọ Olympic iji kwalite ebe dị mma maka ndị egwuregwu niile.
rows.reference: USA Jimnastiks kwadoro ozi Olimpik Kọmitii Amerịka dere ma kwere kwa na oge eruola mgbe onye ọbụla na-eme Olimpiks aghaghị ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ ịhụ na ndị egwuregwu anyị niile nọ na nchekwa.

rows.output: Anyị na-ekweta n'okwu USOC na ọ dị mma ka ndị na-eme egwuregwu anya na klọb anyị, na egwuregwu ha, nwee ike isi na ya pụta site n'ịbanwe n'ime nzukọ anyị, kama ịkwatu ya.
rows.reference: Anyi kwere na ihe USOC dere na odimma ndi egwuregwu anyi na klob ha nakwa egwuregwu ga enweta uru n’ihu karia ma o buru na enwe mgbanwe n’ulo oru anyi kama inapu ndi mmadu asambodo ha.

rows.output: Ndị USA Gymnastics na-akwado nyocha onyeere onwe ya nke nwere ike ịkọwapụta ka a na-eji ndị na-eme ihe ike nke ụdị ndị a kọwara nke ọma site n'aka ndị lanarịrị Larryass, ma na-anabata mgbanwe ọ bụla dị mkpa na nke kwesịrị ekwesị.
rows.reference: Mpaghara jimnasktik nke obodo USA kwadoro nlebara anya nke onwe nke nwere ike igosi ka mmegbu nke ndị lanarịrị ihe mberede Larị Nassar kọwapụtara nwere ike ịbụ ihe metere aka a na-amaghị maka ya na anabatakwa mgbanwe ndị kwesịrị ekwesị.

rows.output: Ndị USA Gymnastics na USOC nwere otu ebumnuche - ime ka egwuregwu nke gymnastics, na ndị ọzọ, dị ka nchekwa dị ka o kwere mee ka ndị na-eme egwuregwu na-eso nrọ ha n'ebe dị nche, dị mma, na nke nwere ike.
rows.reference: Egwuregwu Jimnastik nke mba USA na ndi USOC nwere otu ebumnobi - ime egwuregwu jimnastik, na ndi ozo, enweghi iyi-egwu dika ike kwere nye ogwu egwu isoro nro ha n’uzo n’enweghi iyi-egwu, ziri-ezi na gburu-gburu akwadoro akwado.

rows.output: N'ime 1960s, Brzezinski rụrụ ọrụ maka John F. Kennedy dị ka onye ndụmọdụ ya wee rụọ ọrụ n'ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.
rows.reference: Na 1960 ga, Brzezinski rụụrụ John F. Kennedy ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ ya ma mechaa rụọkwa otu ihe ahụ n'oge ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.

rows.output: N'oge nhọpụta nke 1976, o nyere Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara ihe gbasara mba ofesi, mgbe ahụ ọ rụrụ ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ nchekwa mba (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na-anọchi anya Henry Kissinger.
rows.reference: N’ime nghọpụta nke 1976, ọ dụrụ Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara iwu ndị mba ofesi, wee rụzie ọrụ dịka Onye ndụmọdụ Nchekwa Mba (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na nnọchi Henry Kissinger.

rows.output: N'oge ọ nọ n'ọrụ dị ka NSA, o nyere Carter aka n'ịduzi ihe gbasara ihe gbasara mba ụwa, dị ka Accords nke Camp David, 1978; ime ka mmekọrịta US na China dị mma n'oge 1970s; mgbanwe na Iran, nke mere ka ọ bụrụ nsogbu ndị Iran, 1979; na mbuso agha nke Soviet na Afghanistan, 1979.
rows.reference: Dịka NSA, o nyere Carter aka n’ijikwa ihe omume mbaụwa n’ụzọ kwesiri ekwesi, dị ka Nkwekọrịta Kampụ Devidi, 1978; ihazigharị mmekọrịta US–Chaịna n'afọ ndị dị na ngwụcha agbata afọ 1970 na 1980; Mgbanwe ọchịchị Iran, nke butere nsogbu njigide Iran, 1979; mbuso agha nke Sọviet n’ime Afghanistan, 1979.

rows.output: Ihe nkiri ahụ, nkeara Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone, nwetara nhọpụta na ngalaba niile dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Aghoputara ihe nkiri ahu Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone no n’ime ya maka nturu ugo di iche iche.

rows.output: Gosling na Stone nwetara nhọpụta maka Onye na-eme ihe nkiri kacha mma na onye na-eme ihe nkiri kacha mma n'otu n'otu.
rows.reference: E deturu aha Gosling na Stone n'otu ndị nwere ịnweta akara nturu ugo Best Aktọ na Best Aktres, n'otu n'otu.

rows.output: Ihe ndị ọzọ a họpụtara gụnyere Best Picture, Onye nduzi, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing na Original Screenplay.
rows.reference: Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ gụnyere Foto Kacha, Onye nhazi, Ọrụ nkiri fiim, Nhazi Kọstuum, Ọrụrụ fiim, Exigbo Egwu fiim Mbu, Nhazi mmeputa, Ọrụrụ Ụda, Mwụghari Ụda na Ezigbo Mmemme mbu.

rows.output: Abụ abụọ si na ihe nkiri ahụ, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) na City of Stars, nwetara nhọpụta maka egwu mbụ. Ụlọ ọrụ Lionsgate nwetara nhọpụta iri abụọ na isii - karịa ụlọ ọrụ ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Abụ abụọ sitere n’ihenkiri ahụ, Ọdishọn (Onye Iberibe Ahu Rọrọ Nrọ) na Obodo Kpakpandu gasị, nwetara aha maka abụ mbụ kacha mma. N’ihe nlere nke Lionsgate natara ntinye aka 26 — karia ihe ndi a.

rows.output: N'ehihie Sunday, onye isi ala United States, Donald Trump, n'okwu e nyere site n'aka onye na-ekwuchitere ya, kwuputara na ndị agha US ga-apụ na Syria.
rows.reference: Ka ụbọchị Sọnde nọ na ngwụcha, Onye isi ọchịchị obodo Yunaịted Steeti bụ Donald Trọmp, kwuru n'ozi e nyere site n'aka onye ode akwụkwọ ndị nta akụkọ, nke sịrị na ndị agha obodo US ga ahapụ Sirịa.

rows.output: Mkpebi ahụara mgbe Trump na onye isi ala Turkey, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, kwuru okwu n' ekwentị.
rows.reference: E kwuputara nke a mgbe Trump na Onyeisiala mba Tọkị bụ Rejep Tayyip Erdoghan nwechara mkparịtaụka n'ekwentị.

rows.output: Nkàrà, Tụrụụkụ ga-ewerekwa nche ndị na-alụ ọgụ ISIS nke, nkwupụta ahụ kwuru, mba Europe jụrụ ịlaghachi.
rows.reference: Mba Turkey ga-anarakwa ichebe ndị agha ISIS enwudere ndị, ozi ahụ kwuru, na mba ndị dị na Europe ajụla ịnabata ha ọzọ.

rows.output: Nke a na-ekwupụta na ọ dịkarịa ala ụfọdụ dinosaurs nwere nku, echiche nke a na-ahụkarị ugbu a, ma na-enye nkọwa ihe ndị ihe fossil na-adịghịkarị, dị ka agba na nhazi atọ.
rows.reference: Nke a na-egosi na, opekata mpe, ụfọdụ daịnosọọ nwere abụba; ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nwere echiche a taa, mana ihe ọzọ bụ na ọ na-egosi anyị ihe fosịl enweghị ike igosi, dịka agba na nhazi akụkụ-atọ.

rows.output: Ndị ọkà mmụta sayensị na-ekwu na akpụkpọ anụ a bụ chestnut-brown n'elu ya na ala ma ọ bụ carotenoid-acha ọcha n'okpuru.
rows.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị kwuru na abụba anụmanụ a nwere mgbe ọ na-acha aja aja n'elu ma na-acha ka karotenọịd n'okpuru.

rows.output: Nchọpụta a na-enye nghọta banyere mmepe nke nku n'ụmụ anụmanụ.
rows.reference: Ihe nchọpụta ahụ nyekwara ntụziaka gbasara mmalite ipu nku n'ụmụ nnụnụ.
